name: Lead Discovery (Google Places to Sheets, deduplicated)

parameters.content:
## Lead Discovery (Google Places → AI qualification → Sheets)
Every morning picks the next city + search term (rotation), pulls businesses with websites from Google Maps via Apify, drops junk and duplicates (also across runs), reads each website, lets the model score the lead 0-100 and say honestly whether the gap was actually verified on the site, appends to Google Sheets and posts a daily Telegram report.
**Plug in:** Apify token (YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN), OpenAI, Google Sheets service account, YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
**Test:** run manually; change the city list and search terms for your niche.

Return STRICT minified JSON with EXACTLY these keys:
lead_skoru (integer 0-100). SCORING RULES, be STRICT (do NOT give everyone a high score): if the website text above is EMPTY, cap the score at 45 (we could not verify). Score UNDER 40 if the text shows they ALREADY have a live chat / AI assistant / online booking widget, OR it is a large chain or corporate group, OR there are very few reviews. Score 70+ ONLY if ALL of: independent mid-size clinic, solid review count (real patient volume), AND no sign of online booking / live chat / AI (they rely on phone or email only).
zafiyet_ozeti (ONE honest short English sentence on the real gap; if the site could not be read, honestly say the site could not be read instead of inventing a weakness).
odak_tedaviler (their main treatments in English, e.g. Implants, Invisalign).
ikna_cumlesi (ONE punchy, personalized English cold-email opening line to the owner: praise something specific such as their strong reviews, then point out that WITHOUT an instant 24/7 assistant they likely lose enquiries and missed calls to faster-responding clinics. Focus on SPEED and capturing MISSED enquiries/calls - do NOT mention 'after-midnight' or 'emergencies'. No greeting, just the single sentence.)
zafiyet_dogrulandi (boolean, true or false - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT FIELD). Set it to TRUE only if the website text above contained real, human-readable content AND your gap_summary is based on something you actually READ there. Set it to FALSE if the website text was empty, truncated, or mostly CSS / JavaScript / tracking / schema code, or if you are inferring the weakness rather than seeing it. BE BRUTALLY HONEST here - false is NOT a failure. We use this flag to decide how to contact them: if it is false we will ASK them a question instead of claiming a fault, so a wrong TRUE makes us look like we never looked at their site. When in doubt, use false." }] }) }}

// Daily city + search-term rotation so the lead pool never runs dry (60 cities x 4 terms = 240 combinations, ~8 months fresh)

  "Newport",
  "Aberdeen"
];
const terms = ["dental clinic","dentist","dental practice","private dentist"];
const d = new Date();
const start = new Date(d.getFullYear(), 0, 0);
const dayOfYear = Math.floor((d - start) / 86400000);
const city = cities[dayOfYear % cities.length];
const term = terms[Math.floor(dayOfYear / cities.length) % terms.length];
return [{ json: { city: city + ", United Kingdom", term: term, day: dayOfYear } }];
